# netcup_server_metrics_cpu (Data Source)

The CPU metrics of a netcup server (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_server_metrics_cpu" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
  hours     = 24
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Optional

- `hours` (Number) Number of hours to read, at most 1440.

### Read-Only

- `data` (String) Metrics as JSON, a map from an ISO-8601 timestamp to the values at that time. Use `jsondecode` to read it.
